status: registered before any reference point was sampled and before the chain ran for any reference point; null reference for the wirkungskette_v02 Gegenprobe; exploratory, no tuning
question: How often does a slope point in the same area that is NOT an inventory event have a road or building inside the shortest/longest unchanged v01 runout scenario, or within 25 m of the point, compared with the v02 primary events?
inspected_before_registration: the committed v02 report (reports/wirkungskette_v02/gegenprobe.md/.json); the column list of data/wirkungskette_v01/demo_r10000/cells.parquet, its counts by kind and reason and the distance range of its grid cells; the distances of the 24 v02 primary events from the demo centre (7.06-9.77 km). No reference point was drawn, no route, scenario or infrastructure overlap was computed for any non-event point before this file was committed.
not_claimed: hit rate, sensitivity or any validation of the runout
that the inventory point is the release point
that infrastructure inside a scenario was or would be damaged
that reference points are stable slopes (they are only not in the inventory)
independence of the events: the v02 primary set forms about 3 independent units

chain.hit_rule: preslide.wirkungskette.gegenprobe.present (at least one feature of the type intersects the scenario corridor)
chain.context_rule: preslide.wirkungskette.gegenprobe.nearest_m; object 'at the point' if the nearest feature is at most the corridor half-width (25 m) from the point
chain.rule: everything above is used unchanged from wirkungskette_v01/v02; nothing is adjusted after seeing results

events.source: the v02 primary set, selected again with preslide.wirkungskette.gegenprobe.select_events and config/wirkungskette_v02.json
events.consistency_check: event rows are recomputed with gegenprobe.event_row; ids, scenario infrastructure counts and nearest-object distances must equal reports/wirkungskette_v02/gegenprobe.json, and the v01 config SHA-256 must equal the one recorded there; otherwise the run stops
events.independent_unit: campaign id (RegKatE_ID), else 'ohne Kampagne YYYY-MM' of the event date, exactly as v02 'nach_kampagne' (3 units: Gasen September 2018, June 2018, August 2017)

reference.area_centre: arithmetic mean of the EPSG:31287 coordinates of the 24 v02 primary events (around Gasen)
reference.area_radius_rule: largest distance of a v02 primary event from area_centre, rounded up to the next 100 m
reference.area_note: only cells of the cached 10 km demo window exist; the area circle may be cut by that window and this is reported

area_amended.rule: cells within 2000 m (planar, EPSG:31287) of at least one v02 primary event, inside the cached 10 km window

frames.cells: kind == 'grid' and reason == '' (assessable 90 m cells: slope at least the v01 minimum, catchment not truncated)
kind == 'grid', any reason (adds flat cells and cells with truncated catchment)
frames.reason: the v02 events were not slope-filtered; shows how much the slope filter alone changes the reference

exclusion.inventory: data/raw/geosphere_natural_hazards.json, every point regardless of process, year or position quality
exclusion.reason: position uncertainty of the inventory reaches 100 m, plus the 25 m corridor half-width and margin; a reference cell near any documented point is not a non-event point
exclusion.distance: planar metres in EPSG:31287 (KD-tree on projected coordinates)

reference.sampling: per frame: eligible cells sorted by (row, col), numpy default_rng(seed).choice without replacement; if fewer than sample_size cells are eligible, all are used and this is reported; the same seed is used for both frames

metrics.what: road in the shortest scenario corridor
road in the longest scenario corridor
nearest road at most 25 m from the point
building in the shortest scenario corridor
building in the longest scenario corridor
nearest building at most 25 m from the point

comparisons.primary: road metrics: v02 events with Verkehrsanlagen = 1 against the bewertbar frame; building metrics: v02 events with Bauwerke = 1 against the bewertbar frame (6 comparisons)
comparisons.secondary: the same 6 against the alle_rasterzellen frame; and all 6 metrics for all 24 primary events against both frames (6 + 12 = 18 comparisons)

uncertainty.events: exact cluster bootstrap over the independent units: all k^k ordered resamples of the k units, equal weight; share = pooled hits / pooled n; reported as 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles and min-max. With 3 units this interval is coarse and understates uncertainty
uncertainty.reference: block bootstrap over 1 km x 1 km EPSG:31287 blocks (floor(x/1000), floor(y/1000)), 2000 draws, seed 20261018, percentiles 2.5/97.5
uncertainty.difference: event share minus reference share; 2000 joint draws (events: random resample of the units with replacement; reference: block resample), seed 20261018 + 1, percentiles 2.5/97.5
uncertainty.wording_rule: a difference is described as above or below the null reference only if its interval excludes 0; otherwise 'nicht von der Nullreferenz unterscheidbar'. Always labelled exploratory; never a hit rate or validation

known_limits: point reference unknown: inventory points may mark the damage site, reference cells are cell anchors on slopes
3 independent event units; any interval from them is coarse
the reference area is defined from the event positions; it describes infrastructure density around these events, not in Austria

amendments.what: reference area changed from the centroid circle (area_centre/area_radius_rule) to the union of 2000 m buffers around the 24 v02 primary events
amendments.reason: the registered centroid circle has radius 7400 m because two Breitenau events lie 6-8 km west of the Gasen cluster; it covers 12082 of 36569 assessable cells (a third of the 10 km window) and reaches 5.5 km beyond the window edge, so it is not 'the same area'. 2000 m keeps the reference inside the local valley systems of both event groups (same order as the 2 km v01 pilot radius)
amendments.seen_before_amendment: pilot run (1 and 5 reference points per frame): area centre and radius, cell counts of the circle and the inventory exclusion, end status and inventory distance of one reference point. No reference metric, share, interval or comparison was printed or inspected
amendments.unchanged: everything else: frames, 250 m inventory exclusion, sample size 500, seed, chain, hit rule, context rule, metrics, comparisons, uncertainty and wording rules
